links.outcome: STEMI sensitivity and reperfusion time metrics on AI-disclosure days versus physician-only days
links.effect: AI sensitivity 96.7% vs physician 68.3% (p=0.027); specificity 75.9% vs 84.5%; door-to-balloon 40.0 vs 47.34 min (p=0.001); mortality 17.0% vs 16.77% (p=0.191)
links.quote: Real-time AI-ECG integration in the ED was associated with improved STEMI detection sensitivity and shorter reperfusion-related time metrics, particularly in atypical presentations, and with reduced hospital LOS among admitted patients.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-time deployment and integration of an AI ECG interpretation tool in an emergency department using a pragmatic alternating-day design (physician alone vs. AI output disclosed to physician), measuring clinical process metrics such as door-to-balloon time.

primary.practice: AI output disclosure to physicians in clinical workflow
